lines: At any rate, we had to obtain the MonBox before the yakuza did――
On that basis, Sakura-sensei tried to use her Shadow Escape Arts to approach from a shadow and snatch it, but the instant she stuck her hands out, she was swarmed by Holly Bats, and had to give up.
「Man, they're amazing. The movement and the cries are a perfect recreation!」
She said, making her eyes light up, after she had returned from inside the shadow.
「Is this any time to be impressed?!」
「Crap! These guys may be cute, but they're pesky! I'll electrocute them all at once!」
Shikanosuke enveloped his body in electricity. I hurried to stop him.
「Most likely, the true identity of these things is the souls that got sucked up.」
Shizuru-sensei had said that the “slave units” were using the souls of Hellish bugs and things to reproduce the summoning feature.
And we knew that, after using them a few times, those “slaves” would suck up their owner's soul, and transfer it to this “master unit”.
「Given that, it's not hard to imagine what the souls being used in this “master unit's” summoning are.」
「Hah...... That was close. Glad you stopped me, Fuuma!」
If we were to hurt the bats with Taimanin ninja arts, the souls of the victims would be damaged.
If that happened, then even if we went to all the trouble of getting the box back, the victims would probably not be able to return to normal.
「But, what on earth can we do to get the box without harming these bats?!」
Hebiko was also repeatedly reaching her octopus legs out for the box, only to get bitten by the bats and retreat.
I quickly turned it over in my mind.
「Even if we try to do a surprise attack with Sakura-sensei's Shadow Escape――」
「Those boys have no shadows, so it'd be impossible, right?」
「They have no physical form, so there's no shadow either, huh? Isn't there anything we can do......?」
When I looked at the opposite side, Shizuru-sensei was warding off the yakuza.
I doubted they would be any match for her if she got serious, but if she swung her rose whip the wrong way, she would wind up harming the Holly Bats.
For that reason, it appeared that she was only able to use minor skills, and the most she could do was not allow the yakuza to get close to the MonBox.
「We won't get anywhere if we keep doing this forever, will we......?」
「What's the matter?! C'mon! Give up and fork over the box already!」
Taking no notice of the boss's angry shouting, Shizuru-sensei thought hard about it.
She suddenly raised her face, and then produced a cute little herbal leaf from her cleavage.
Shizuru-sensei blew on the leaf, and sent it flying in the direction of the MonBox.
At which point, before our very eyes, the leaf sprouted a stem, which became thick with foliage, and grew into a bush that covered the box in mere seconds.
「It smells so sharp! It feels like Hebiko's suckers are going numb!!」
Sharp, almost freezing stimulation assaulted my nasal cavity. It was so strong that Hebiko, who had an acute sense of smell through her suckers, undid her beast transformation at once.
However, what reacted to that smell even more strongly than us was――
The Holly Bats writhed painfully, and plummeted to the ground.
「Mint. I pinched one of the pieces that was on the cakes before☆」
「Mint...... Of course! Bats can't stand peppermint, right?!」
Come to think of it, I recalled that one time, when bats made nests in the storehouse at home, I had helped Saika spread peppermint oil on the window screen.
「What's more, it's no ordinary mint. On top of enhancing the smell as much as I can with my Ninja Arts, I've made sure it gives off its stimulant effect all around.」
「Brutal...... You wouldn't get a smell this strong with normal mint, would you......?」
In any case, with this, we had repelled the Holly Bats. All we had left to do was collect the MonBox and――
「Kekekeh! Thanks! Long's there's no bats, it's mine!」
The first to move was the yakuza boss.
He rushed into the mint, which had grown into a full bush, to try and snatch the MonBox before us.
「Uuh?! What is this?! Hiiih?! My eyes!!! It hurrrts!!!」
「I did say that I enhanced it to the max with my arts, didn't I?」
「Get too close, and even a human will suffer damage to their sensory organs♪」
Shizuru-sensei created a rose whip, and, with a sidelong glance at the boss (who was writhing around, dribbling tears and mucus), smoothly extracted the MonBox.
She hurriedly closed the lid, at which point the knocked-out Holly Bats disappeared.
「Sh-Shit...... The source of money we worked so hard to collect...... Ahhh, my eyes hurt......」
「Do you get it?! This is what happens when you cheat people to make your money!!」
With a hundred times more resentment, Sakura-sensei lectured the boss, who was still holding his eyes and groaning.
「You shouldn't be working for a boss like this, either...... Huh? Where's the shop boy?」
Come to think of it, I hadn't seen the figure of that employee for some time. Had he run away?
「Boss! Sorry I kept you waiting! I went and called for backup!!」
The employee who had disappeared returned through the shop's rear door, and no sooner had he done so than hoodlum after hoodlum came in after him.
The hoodlums surrounded us, in such large numbers that they filled the room completely.
「Oh dear. I guess I wasn't keeping an eye on the sales boy's movements.」
Shizuru-sensei casually shrugged her shoulders, and not in a way that particularly said, “Oh no.”
「Kukuku, the tables've turned, haven't they? You guys're done for now. Do it, boys!!」
On the signal of their boss, who had recovered from the mint, the men sprang at us in unison――
Or so we thought. But in fact, they all fell down with a thud. As if their legs had been tripped by something.
「Oi, what're you guys doing?! Hurry up and do it!」
The men tried to stand up, but every time they did, they kept falling down again, as though the ground had been swept out from under their feet by something.
It was like they were desperately trying to stand up while wearing leather shoes on top of slippery frozen snow.
「What is this?! It's like my technique!」
Sakura-sensei made her eyes light up.
「Indeed...... It's like the shadows are tripping up their feet, isn't it?」
「I don't really get it, but this is our chance! Take this! Electric Escape Art: Spark!」
「Then, straight after that, Octopus Leg Four-Blade Style!!!」
Without them even understanding what was going on, the men were beaten up, and we successfully confiscated the MonBox and took it back to Gosha for analysis.
「The confiscated MonBox has been analyzed in Gosha and disenchanted. The victims appear to be slowly regaining consciousness.」

「The culprits look to have been a small group. A demon merchant who makes his money selling human souls, joining forces with a loose gang of humans who have been making their money counterfeiting and reselling.」
「They don't seem to have any connection to any big organizations. Well, if it were Nomad or Ryuumon, I doubt they would have caused such a petty incident, though, would they?」
「At any rate, to think that a demon-related incident would occur somewhere so close-by... We'll have to be all the more diligent in our Taimanin work, won't we?」

「Yeah. That's for sure, Shizuru-sensei.
......By the way.」
Resolving myself, I raised my face and looked firmly at Shizuru-sensei, who was in front of my eyes.
「Why are you in my room, dressed like that again?!」

Indeed. Shizuru-sensei, who was seriously discussing the details of the case, was, for some reason, in my room, wearing the Sexy Santa clothes that she had donned 「to avoid being suspicious」 in Maesaki City.
「Why, Santa visits good boys' houses, right?♪」
「Well, sure, today is Christmas Eve, but......!!」
Though it may have been Christmas Eve, today was an ordinary day. I hadn't done anything in particular, and had passed the time after school in the library, as usual.
And then, when I returned home in the evening, I was told that Shizuru-sensei had come to visit and give me a report on the incident. And so――
When I hurried back to my room, she was waiting, wearing the aforementioned Santa outfit.
（Alone together in my room on Christmas Eve, dressed like that......!! This teacher must be enjoying my reactions for sure.）
I say alone together, but there was no doubt that Young Sakura, who was sulking after having her fake MonBox confiscated, was listening from the shadows.
And Tokiko seemed to be paying close attention as well, as she had been constantly coming to offer tea refills for some time.
（No matter what happens, you can't do anything careless. You can't......! Clear your mind......）
Completely ignoring my resolve, Shizuru-sensei was sitting on the raised tatami mat, and gracefully crossing her legs.
Each time she did, though, her risqué thighs swayed in front of my eyes, and I had a very hard time knowing where to look.
「But in the end, the only thing that's still a mystery is “That”.」
「That incident at the end, where the yakuza kept falling down. There was no mechanism like that in the box, and Sakura-sensei says she doesn't know either......」
It was awkward to be told that.
I had heard from the person herself after the fact that it was the doing of Young Sakura, who had been hiding in that place.
It seemed that, after she had received her MonBox, Adult Sakura had arrived in place of her, so she had hidden in a shadow, and had been watching like that.
「Fuuma-kun, you're not hiding anything, are you?」
「Eh?! I-I don't know what you mean!!」
「Hmmm～～～, suspicious! Confess and make it easier on yourself. Shizuru-sensei's lips are sealed♪」
Shizuru-sensei leaned straight forward. Her necktie, which was sandwiched between her large breasts, formed strained-looking creases.
（This is bad...... She's caught on somehow.）
Could she be in this outfit on purpose, to unsettle me? Since this was Shizuru-sensei, it was possible.
「Hmmm... It looks like tonight's going to drag on, eh?♪ I wonder if I should have you put me up. This bed could take two people sleeping in it, right?♪」
A joke......? No, with this teacher, it might be serious.
Either way, it looked like Sensei was intent on remaining here until I confessed.
（Dear, dear...... Looks like it's going to be a long night......）
While tormented by sweet anguish, my Christmas Eve night wore on.
